items.title: 14.5.1 Impact of burning fossil fuels on the atmosphere (fossil fuels jalane ka asar) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.5.1 with Figure 14.2, printed page 311.

blocks.text: Fossil fuels ka jalna aaj ke climate change ki sab se bari wajah hai; yeh zameen ke ecosystem ko badal raha hai aur insanon aur environment ki sehat ke problems (masle) paida kar raha hai. Fossil fuels ka jalna earth system (zameen ka poora system) par kai tarah asar dalta hai, jaise greenhouse gases ka emission (yani hawa mein chhorna), air pollution aur volatile organic compounds.

blocks.alt: Gaon ka scene. Halke laal teer Power stations (combustion), Motor vehicles (combustion) aur Livestock se SO2, NO2 aur NH3 tak uthte hain, oopar 'Emitted Pollutants' likha hai. Laal lakeerein in gases ko particles/aerosols SO4 2−, NO3−, NH4+ tak aur neeche khet aur talab par 'Dry Deposition' tak le jati hain. Neele teer aerosols se 'Dry Deposition' aur jangal wali pahari par barish wale badal 'Wet Deposition' tak jate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.2: Air pollutants ke atmosphere par effects (asar) (kitab ki Figure 14.2 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Power stations aur gariyan (combustion) SO₂ aur NO₂ chhorti hain, aur livestock (maweshi) NH₃. Hawa mein yeh gases particles/aerosols (bohat chhote particles) mein badal jati hain: SO₂ se sulphate (SO₄²⁻), NO₂ se nitrate (NO₃⁻) aur NH₃ se ammonium (NH₄⁺). Yeh do tareeqon se zameen par wapas aati hain: dry deposition (khud neeche baith jana) aur wet deposition (barish ke saath girna), jo acid rain ki wajah banti hai.

blocks.prompt: Fossil fuels ka jalna aaj ke climate change ki sab se bari wajah kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Coal, oil ya gas jalne se woh carbon jo lakhon saal zameen ke andar band tha, CO₂ ban kar hawa mein aa jata hai, saath methane aur nitrous oxide bhi. Yeh greenhouse gases zameen se nikalti garmi rokti hain, aur industry ke daur se in ka lagatar barhna zameen ke barhte temperature se mail khata hai.

items: Fossil fuels ka jalna climate change ki bari wajah; greenhouse gases, air pollution aur VOCs ecosystem aur sehat ko nuqsan dete hain.
